source.title: NOAA ETOPO1 global relief model
source.citation: Amante, C. and B. W. Eakins (2009), ETOPO1 1 Arc-Minute Global Relief Model: Procedures, Data Sources and Analysis. NOAA Technical Memorandum NESDIS NGDC-24.
source.license: Free use and redistribution; NOAA source terms apply.

grid.registration: Grid-node samples displayed at their coordinates; row-major, north to south then west to east.
grid.method: Select every sixth ETOPO1 grid point (0.1 degree spacing). No averaging or interpolation. Mask grid centers outside the Census 2025 generalized CONUS outlines.

elevation.label: Elevation context
elevation.description: Static relief from the 2009 ETOPO1 model, sampled at 0.1 degree spacing. These are broad context values, not a November average.
elevation.aggregation: Systematic spatial sampling; no temporal average.
elevation.limitations: Coarse relief cannot resolve local slope, surface roughness, obstacles, or traversal. Source includes bathymetry; generalized boundary masking can retain coastal or lake-edge samples. Negative values are preserved, not treated as missing.

validation.maskDescription: Generalized national cartographic outline, not an exact land/water classification.
